title: An error type with fields
hints: Any type with an Error() string method is an error. Callers extract your type, fields and all, with errors.As(err, &target) where target is a *ValidationError.

Give Error a pointer receiver and return &ValidationError{…} from Validate. errors.As(err, &ve) with ve of type *ValidationError only matches if the error really is a *ValidationError, not a ValidationError value.

func (e *ValidationError) Error() string { return e.Field + ": " + e.Reason }; in Validate: if u.Name == "" { return &ValidationError{Field: "name", Reason: "must not be empty"} } and so on; return nil at the end.
